# docker_compose_images (Data Source)

Lists the images the containers of a compose project use, like `docker compose images`: one entry per container (stopped ones included) with the image inspect fields.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "docker_compose_images" "shop" {
  name = "shop"
}

output "image_digests" {
  value = data.docker_compose_images.shop.image_digest_refs
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The compose project name (`com.docker.compose.project` label, CLI `--project-name`).

### Optional

- `services` (List of String) Only these services (default: every service of the project).

### Read-Only

- `content_sha256` (String) Hex SHA-256 of `images_json`.
- `docker_server_version` (String) Docker Engine version of the daemon.
- `engine_api_version` (String) Engine API version negotiated with the daemon.
- `image_digest_refs` (Map of String) Map of service name to the image's first repo digest (`repo@sha256:...`), when it has one.
- `image_ids` (Map of String) Map of service name to the image ID.
- `image_refs` (Map of String) Map of service name to the image reference its containers were created from.
- `images` (Attributes List) Images used by project containers: service, container and the image's inspect fields. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--images))
- `images_json` (String) JSON array of the images used by the project's containers (one entry per container).

<a id="nestedatt--images"></a>
### Nested Schema for `images`

Read-Only:

- `architecture` (String) Upstream `Architecture`.
- `container_name` (String) Upstream `Names`.
- `created` (String) Upstream `Created`.
- `id` (String) Upstream `Id`.
- `os` (String) Upstream `Os`.
- `os_version` (String) Upstream `OsVersion`.
- `repo_digests` (List of String) Upstream `RepoDigests`.
- `repo_tags` (List of String) Upstream `RepoTags`.
- `service` (String) Upstream `Labels[com.docker.compose.service]`.
- `size` (Number) Upstream `Size`.
- `variant` (String) Upstream `Variant`.
